entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: Devastating twenty-year conflict between mortals and the kami on Kamigawa, central event of the Kamigawa Cycle.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the Kami War took place.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: Most powerful ruler on Kamigawa who instigated the war by kidnapping O-Kagachi's child.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Mightiest of all the kami, whose child was kidnapped by Konda.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Child and scion of O-Kagachi, imprisoned in a stone disk by Konda and later freed.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Princess who freed the kidnapped scion and defeated O-Kagachi and Lord Konda.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Black magician who aided Michiko Konda.

entities.name: Moonfolk
entities.description: Allies of Konda who helped him enact the ritual.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits/gods of Kamigawa who turned against the physical world.

entities.name: Final Battle at Jukai Forest
entities.description: Final battle of the Kami War.

events.summary: Konda performs an arcane ritual with moonfolk and wizard allies and kidnaps O-Kagachi's child, imprisoning it in a stone disk.
events.quote: Konda tore the god-child out of the spirit realm and brought it into the physical world

events.summary: Konda ceases to age and shuts himself in his inner chambers.
events.quote: From that day forward, Konda ceased to age.

events.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world and mortals fight back in a losing battle.
events.quote: The kami began to attack the physical world to reclaim

events.summary: In the twentieth year Michiko Konda, aided by Toshiro Umezawa, frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Lord Konda, ending the war.
events.quote: managed to free the kidnapped scion
